judgments.rewrite_hint: “The idea was that those carrying the cargo would repay the money the United States spends to keep the strait safe.” Remove the unsupported identification of cargo carriers as payers; say only that the proposal was presented as reimbursement for U.S. security costs (HF-003).

「遠い海峡の不安は、原油を通じてガソリンや物流の値段にもつながります。」Limit the statement to the continuing Strait-related concerns and the reported Brent crude futures movement; remove the asserted effects on gasoline prices and goods-moving costs (HF-006).
